# ArchiveEntryKind

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - enum.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Use qualified values rather than raw integers. These are open nominal enums: each enum has its own type, and its known values are listed below. Host operations may reject unknown or unsupported values even though the enum can store them. See [enum rules and bit operations](../../../new_ppl.md#enum--endenum-declaration-350).

The default value is `ArchiveEntryKind.File` (the first declared member).

## Values

| Name | Integer value | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.File` | `0` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.Directory` | `1` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.SymbolicLink` | `2` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.HardLink` | `3` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.Special` | `4` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |
| `ArchiveEntryKind.Unknown` | `5` | File, Directory, SymbolicLink, HardLink, Special or Unknown. Only regular files may be read or extracted. |

## Has

```PPL
ArchiveEntryKind.Has(ArchiveEntryKind mask) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Returns BOOLEAN: true if all bits in the mask are set. Receiver and mask must have the same enum type and are evaluated once, receiver first. No intermediate enum value is constructed. A zero mask always returns true; use equality with the zero member to test that no bits are set. Available from language 350; requires runtime 400.
